posts.headline: Nine straight editions of chronicling the fall, and Put it in Ra is STILL 0-2 — One Nut Barner's 20-8, 1.5-average-finish résumé isn't a fluke anymore, it's a ghost story.
posts.detail: 238.06 points-for says the roster isn't the problem, but somehow this 'league-best pedigree' franchise can't buy a win through two weeks.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are 2-0 with a league-high 344.18 points and this column has now begged this league SEVEN straight days to wake up to triciagloston.
posts.detail: A middling 6-7-1 career résumé says nobody expected this, but the scoreboard says she's lapping the field right now.

posts.headline: Thicks is 2-0 for the ninth edition running, and I'm still not buying the coronation — 263.62 points is a champion sneaking through the side door, not kicking it in.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record and a 5.5 average finish means the ring means nothing until the points-for actually looks like a title defense.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is 0-2 with a league-worst 165.84 points, and Auntie Thomas is now personally guaranteeing his 10-average-finish résumé stays intact.
posts.detail: Every single edition this week has ended with this same line, and every single day Pharaoh23 makes sure it stays true.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT drops to 0-2 with a league-worst 196.8 points, and the Ultimate Light Skin's judgment day rolls into a seventh straight edition of fire and brimstone.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record and the infamous defensive-player-first-overall draft sin means Eli's flock is still wandering the desert with no promised land in sight.
